from typing import List, Tuple, Dict

DAY = "Monday"
WORK_START = 9 * 60
WORK_END = 17 * 60
DURATION = 60

def to_min(t: str) -> int:
    h, m = map(int, t.split(':'))
    return h * 60 + m

def fmt(m: int) -> str:
    return f"{m // 60:02d}:{m % 60:02d}"

busy: Dict[str, List[Tuple[int, int]]] = {
    "James": [
        (to_min("11:30"), to_min("12:00")),

        (to_min("12:30"), to_min("13:30")),
        (to_min("14:30"), to_min("16:30")),
    ],
}

def free(participant: str, start: int, end: int) -> bool:

    end = start + DURATION
    if all(free(p, start, end) for p in busy):
        solution = [DAY, fmt(start), fmt(end)]

WORK_START = 9 * 60
WORK_END = 17 * 60
MEETING_LENGTH = 30
DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday"]

schedule = {
    "Jean": {
        "Monday": [],
        "Tuesday": [(11 * 60 + 30, 12 * 60), (16 * 60, 16 * 60 + 30)],
    },
    "Doris": {
        "Monday": [
            (9 * 60, 11 * 60 + 30),
            (12 * 60, 12 * 60 + 30),
            (13 * 60 + 30, 16 * 60),
            (16 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60),
        ],
        "Tuesday": [(9 * 60, 17 * 60)],
    },
}

def is_available(day, start, end):
    for person in schedule:
        for busy_start, busy_end in schedule[person].get(day, []):
            if start < busy_end and end > busy_start:
                return False
    return True

def fmt(minute):
    return f"{minute // 60:02d}:{minute % 60:02d}"

def main():
    for day in DAYS:
        for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - MEETING_LENGTH + 1):
            end = start + MEETING_LENGTH
            if day == "Monday" and end > 14 * 60:
                continue
            if is_available(day, start, end):
                print([day, fmt(start), fmt(end)])
                return

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

def to_min(hhmm):
    h, m = map(int, hhmm.split(":"))
    return h*60+m

def fmt(mins):
    return f"{mins//60:02d}:{mins%60:02d}"

work_start = to_min("09:00")
work_end = to_min("17:00")
duration = 30

busy = {
    "Amy": {
        "Monday": [],
        "Tuesday": [],
        "Wednesday": [(to_min("11:00"), to_min("11:30")), (to_min("13:30"), to_min("14:00"))],
    },
    "Pamela": {
        "Monday": [(to_min("09:00"), to_min("10:30")), (to_min("11:00"), to_min("16:30"))],
        "Tuesday": [(to_min("09:00"), to_min("09:30")), (to_min("10:00"), to_min("17:00"))],
        "Wednesday": [(to_min("09:00"), to_min("09:30")), (to_min("10:00"), to_min("11:00")), (to_min("11:30"), to_min("13:30")), (to_min("14:30"), to_min("15:00")), (to_min("16:00"), to_min("16:30"))],
    }
}

participants = ["Amy", "Pamela"]
preferred_start = to_min("16:00")

def is_free(person, day, start, end):
    return all(end <= b_start or start >= b_end for b_start,b_end in busy[person][day])

def works(day, start):
    end = start + duration
    if start < work_start or end > work_end:

        for start in range(work_start, work_end - duration + 1, 30):
            if works(day, start):
                return [day, fmt(start), fmt(start+duration)]
    return None

print(solve())

def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def to_hhmm(t):

DURATION = 30
WORK_START = to_minutes("09:00")
WORK_END = to_minutes("17:00")
PREFERRED_NOT_BEFORE = to_minutes("16:00")
DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday"]

BUSY = {
    "Amy": {
        "Monday": [],
        "Tuesday": [],
        "Wednesday": [
            (to_minutes("11:00"), to_minutes("11:30")),
            (to_minutes("13:30"), to_minutes("14:00")),
        ],
    },
    "Pamela": {

        ],
        "Tuesday": [

            (to_minutes("10:00"), to_minutes("11:00")),
            (to_minutes("11:30"), to_minutes("13:30")),
            (to_minutes("14:30"), to_minutes("15:00")),
            (to_minutes("16:00"), to_minutes("16:30")),
        ],
    },
}

def is_free(person, day, start, end):
    for busy_start, busy_end in BUSY[person][day]:
        if start < busy_end and end > busy_start:
            return False
    return True

def works(day, start):
    end = start + DURATION
    if start < WORK_START or end > WORK_END:
        return False
    if start < PREFERRED_NOT_BEFORE:
        return False
    for person in BUSY:
        if not is_free(person, day, start, end):
            return False
    return True

def solve():
    for day in DAYS:
        for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1):
            if works(day, start):
                return [day, to_hhmm(start), to_hhmm(start + DURATION)]
    return None

print(solve())

def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def minutes_to_hhmm(t):
    return f"{t // 60:02d}:{t % 60:02d}"

busy = {
    "Kimberly": [
        (to_minutes("10:00"), to_minutes("10:30")),
        (to_minutes("11:00"), to_minutes("12:00")),
        (to_minutes("16:00"), to_minutes("16:30")),
    ],
    "Megan": [],
    "Marie": [
        (to_minutes("10:00"), to_minutes("11:00")),
        (to_minutes("11:30"), to_minutes("15:00")),
        (to_minutes("16:00"), to_minutes("16:30")),
    ],
    "Diana": [
        (to_minutes("09:30"), to_minutes("10:00")),
        (to_minutes("10:30"), to_minutes("14:30")),
        (to_minutes("15:30"), to_minutes("17:00")),
    ],
}

work_start = to_minutes("09:00")
work_end = to_minutes("17:00")
duration = 30
earliest_start = to_minutes("10:00")

        if not (end <= b_start or start >= b_end):

    if all(is_free(person, start, end) for person in busy):
        print(f"['Monday', '{minutes_to_hhmm(start)}', '{minutes_to_hhmm(end)}']")
        break

    return h * 60 + m

def format_time(mins):
    return "{:02d}:{:02d}".format(mins // 60, mins % 60)

# Each tuple is a busy interval [start, end) for that participant.
schedules = {
    "Wayne": [],
    "Melissa": [
        ("10:00", "11:00"),
        ("12:30", "14:00"),
        ("15:00", "15:30"),
    ],
    "Catherine": [],
    "Gregory": [
        ("12:30", "13:00"),
        ("15:30", "16:00"),
    ],
    "Victoria": [
        ("09:00", "09:30"),
        ("10:30", "11:30"),
        ("13:00", "14:00"),
        ("14:30", "15:00"),
        ("15:30", "16:30"),
    ],
    "Thomas": [
        ("10:00", "12:00"),
        ("12:30", "13:00"),
        ("14:30", "16:00"),
    ],
    "Jennifer": [
        ("09:00", "09:30"),
        ("10:00", "10:30"),
        ("11:00", "13:00"),
        ("13:30", "14:30"),
        ("15:00", "15:30"),
        ("16:00", "16:30"),
    ],
}

busy_intervals = [
    (parse_time(start), parse_time(end))
    for intervals in schedules.values()
    for start, end in intervals
]

answer = None
for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1):
    if start < WAYNE_PREF_START:
        continue
    end = start + DURATION

    conflict = False
    for b_start, b_end in busy_intervals:
        if start < b_end and end > b_start:
            conflict = True
            break

    if not conflict:
        answer = (start, end)
        break

if answer is None:
    raise RuntimeError("No valid meeting time found.")

print([DAY, format_time(answer[0]), format_time(answer[1])])
```

def to_minutes(time_str):
    hours, minutes = map(int, time_str.split(":"))
    return hours * 60 + minutes

def to_hhmm(minutes):
    return "{:02d}:{:02d}".format(minutes // 60, minutes % 60)

days = ("Monday", "Tuesday")
work_start = to_minutes("09:00")
work_end = to_minutes("17:00")
duration = 30
day_latest_end = {
    "Monday": work_end,
    "Tuesday": to_minutes("16:30"),
}

schedules = {
    "Jesse": {
        "Monday": [("13:30", "14:00"), ("14:30", "15:00")],
        "Tuesday": [("09:00", "09:30"), ("13:00", "13:30"), ("14:00", "15:00")],
    },
    "Lawrence": {
        "Monday": [("09:00", "17:00")],
        "Tuesday": [("09:30", "10:30"), ("11:30", "12:30"), ("13:00", "13:30"), ("14:30", "15:00"), ("15:30", "16:30")],
    },
}

busy_by_day = {}
for day in days:
    busy_by_day[day] = []
    for person in ("Jesse", "Lawrence"):
        for start_text, end_text in schedules[person].get(day, []):
            busy_by_day[day].append((to_minutes(start_text), to_minutes(end_text)))

def main():
    for day in days:
        for start in range(work_start, work_end, duration):
            end = start + duration
            if end > day_latest_end[day]:
                continue
            if any(start < busy_end and busy_start < end for busy_start, busy_end in busy_by_day[day]):
                continue
            print([day, to_hhmm(start), to_hhmm(end)])
            return

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

def free_slots(day):
    busy = []
    for intervals in BLOCKED[day].values():
        for start, end in intervals:
            if end > WORK_START and start < WORK_END:
                busy.append((max(start, WORK_START), min(end, WORK_END)))

    busy.sort()
    merged = []
    for start, end in busy:
        if not merged or start > merged[-1][1]:
            merged.append([start, end])
        elif end > merged[-1][1]:
            merged[-1][1] = end

    slots = []
    cursor = WORK_START
    for start, end in merged:
        if cursor < start:
            slots.append((cursor, min(start, WORK_END)))
        if end > cursor:
            cursor = end
        if cursor >= WORK_END:
            break
    if cursor < WORK_END:
        slots.append((cursor, WORK_END))
    return slots

def solve():
    for day in ("Monday", "Tuesday"):
        for start, end in free_slots(day):
            if end - start >= MEETING_DURATION:

def to_minutes(time_str):
    h, m = map(int, time_str.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def to_hhmm(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

days = ("Monday", "Tuesday")
work_start = to_minutes("09:00")
work_end = to_minutes("17:00")
duration = 30
day_latest_end = {
    "Monday": work_end,
    "Tuesday": to_minutes("16:30"),
}

schedules = {
    "Jesse": {
        "Monday": [("13:30", "14:00"), ("14:30", "15:00")],
        "Tuesday": [("09:00", "09:30"), ("13:00", "13:30"), ("14:00", "15:00")],
    },
    "Lawrence": {
        "Monday": [("09:00", "17:00")],
        "Tuesday": [("09:30", "10:30"), ("11:30", "12:30"), ("13:00", "13:30"), ("14:30", "15:00"), ("15:30", "16:30")],
    },
}

busy_by_day = {}
for day in days:
    busy_by_day[day] = []
    for person in ("Jesse", "Lawrence"):
        for start_text, end_text in schedules[person].get(day, []):
            busy_by_day[day].append((to_minutes(start_text), to_minutes(end_text)))

def main():
    for day in days:
        for start in range(work_start, work_end, duration):
            end = start + duration
            if end > day_latest_end[day]:
                continue
            if any(start < busy_end and busy_start < end for busy_start, busy_end in busy_by_day[day]):
                continue
            print([day, to_hhmm(start), to_hhmm(end)])
            return

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

def to_minutes(time_str):
    hours, minutes = map(int, time_str.split(":"))
    return hours * 60 + minutes

def to_hhmm(minutes):
    return "{:02d}:{:02d}".format(minutes // 60, minutes % 60)

days = ("Monday", "Tuesday")
work_start = to_minutes("09:00")
work_end = to_minutes("17:00")
duration = 30
day_latest_end = {
    "Monday": work_end,
    "Tuesday": to_minutes("16:30"),
}

schedules = {
    "Jesse": {
        "Monday": [("13:30", "14:00"), ("14:30", "15:00")],
        "Tuesday": [("09:00", "09:30"), ("13:00", "13:30"), ("14:00", "15:00")],
    },
    "Lawrence": {
        "Monday": [("09:00", "17:00")],
        "Tuesday": [("09:30", "10:30"), ("11:30", "12:30"), ("13:00", "13:30"), ("14:30", "15:00"), ("15:30", "16:30")],
    },
}

busy_by_day = {}
for day in days:
    busy_by_day[day] = []
    for person in ("Jesse", "Lawrence"):
        for start_text, end_text in schedules[person].get(day, []):
            busy_by_day[day].append((to_minutes(start_text), to_minutes(end_text)))

def main():
    for day in days:
        for start in range(work_start, work_end, duration):
            end = start + duration
            if end > day_latest_end[day]:
                continue
            if any(start < busy_end and busy_start < end for busy_start, busy_end in busy_by_day[day]):
                continue
            print([day, to_hhmm(start), to_hhmm(end)])
            return

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday"]

def to_minutes(hhmm):
    h, m = map(int, hhmm.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

def conflicts(start, end, busy_start, busy_end):
    return start < busy_end and end > busy_start

def is_free(schedule, start, end):
    for busy_start, busy_end in schedule:
        if conflicts(start, end, busy_start, busy_end):
            return False
    return True

MEGAN = {

    "Thursday": [(to_minutes("13:30"), to_minutes("14:30")), (to_minutes("15:00"), to_minutes("15:30"))],
}

DANIEL = {

}

def earliest_slot():
    work_start = 9 * 60
    work_end = 17 * 60
    duration = 60

    for day in DAYS:
        for start in range(work_start, work_end - duration + 1):
            end = start + duration
            if is_free(MEGAN[day], start, end) and is_free(DANIEL[day], start, end):
                return [day, to_hhmm(start), to_hhmm(end)]
    return None

print(earliest_slot())

def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def to_hhmm(mins):
    return f"{mins // 60:02d}:{mins % 60:02d}"

DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday"]
DAY_ORDER = {day: i for i, day in enumerate(DAYS)}
WORK_START = to_minutes("09:00")
WORK_END = to_minutes("17:00")
DURATION = 30

RAW_BUSY = {
    "Eugene": {
        "Monday": [
            ("11:00", "12:00"),
            ("13:30", "14:00"),
            ("14:30", "15:00"),
            ("16:00", "16:30"),
        ],
        "Wednesday": [
            ("09:00", "09:30"),
            ("11:00", "11:30"),
            ("12:00", "12:30"),
            ("13:30", "15:00"),
        ],
        "Thursday": [
            ("09:30", "10:00"),
            ("11:00", "12:30"),
        ],
        "Friday": [
            ("10:30", "11:00"),
            ("12:00", "12:30"),
            ("13:00", "13:30"),
        ],
    },
    "Eric": {
        "Monday": [("09:00", "17:00")],
        "Tuesday": [("09:00", "17:00")],
        "Wednesday": [
            ("09:00", "11:30"),
            ("12:00", "14:00"),
            ("14:30", "16:30"),
        ],
        "Thursday": [("09:00", "17:00")],
        "Friday": [
            ("09:00", "11:00"),
            ("11:30", "17:00"),
        ],
    },
}

BUSY = {}
for person, days in RAW_BUSY.items():
    BUSY[person] = {}
    for day, intervals in days.items():
        BUSY[person][day] = [(to_minutes(s), to_minutes(e)) for s, e in intervals]

def has_overlap(person, day, start, end):
    for busy_start, busy_end in BUSY[person].get(day, []):
        if start < busy_end and end > busy_start:
            return True
    return False

candidates = []
for day in DAYS:
    for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1):
        end = start + DURATION
        if all(not has_overlap(person, day, start, end) for person in BUSY):
            candidates.append((day, start))

# Prefer non-Wednesday candidates; otherwise use normal weekday order.
candidates.sort(key=lambda item: (item[0] == "Wednesday", DAY_ORDER[item[0]], item[1]))

day, start = candidates[0]
print([day, to_hhmm(start), to_hhmm(start + DURATION)])
```

    return h * 60 + m

def to_time(mins):
    return f"{mins // 60:02d}:{mins % 60:02d}"

def overlaps(start, end, busy_intervals):
    for busy_start, busy_end in busy_intervals:
        if start < busy_end and end > busy_start:
            return True
    return False

def main():
    work_start = to_minutes("09:00")
    work_end = to_minutes("17:00")
    duration = 30
    day = "Monday"

    schedule = {
        "Raymond": [
            (to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("09:30")),
            (to_minutes("11:30"), to_minutes("12:00")),
            (to_minutes("13:00"), to_minutes("13:30")),
            (to_minutes("15:00"), to_minutes("15:30")),

            (to_minutes("12:00"), to_minutes("13:00")),
            (to_minutes("16:30"), to_minutes("17:00")),

            (to_minutes("10:00"), to_minutes("11:00")),
            (to_minutes("12:00"), to_minutes("13:00")),
            (to_minutes("14:00"), to_minutes("14:30")),
            (to_minutes("16:00"), to_minutes("17:00")),
        ],
    }

    billy_no_after = to_minutes("15:00")

    for start in range(work_start, work_end - duration + 1):
        end = start + duration
        if end > billy_no_after:
            continue
        if all(not overlaps(start, end, intervals) for intervals in schedule.values()):
            print([day, to_time(start), to_time(end)])
            return

main()

    if available(start)
)

def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def fmt(m):
    return f"{m // 60:02d}:{m % 60:02d}"

day = "Monday"
work_start = to_minutes("09:00")
work_end = to_minutes("17:00")
duration = 30

busy = {
    "Christine": ["09:30-10:30", "12:00-12:30", "13:00-13:30", "14:30-15:00", "16:00-16:30"],
    "Janice": [],
    "Bobby": ["12:00-12:30", "14:30-15:00"],
    "Elizabeth": ["09:00-09:30", "11:30-13:00", "13:30-14:00", "15:00-15:30", "16:00-17:00"],
    "Tyler": ["09:00-11:00", "12:00-12:30", "13:00-13:30", "15:30-16:00", "16:30-17:00"],
    "Edward": ["09:00-09:30", "10:00-11:00", "11:30-14:00", "14:30-15:30", "16:00-17:00"],
}

intervals = []
for name, entries in busy.items():
    for entry in entries:
        start_s, end_s = entry.split("-")
        intervals.append((name, to_minutes(start_s), to_minutes(end_s)))

janice_pref_end = to_minutes("13:00")

def free(start):
    end = start + duration
    if start < work_start or end > work_end:
        return False
    for name, b_start, b_end in intervals:
        if start < b_end and b_start < end:
            return False
    if end > janice_pref_end:
        return False
    return True

best = None
for start in range(work_start, work_end - duration + 1):
    if free(start):
        best = start
        break

if best is not None:
    print([day, fmt(best), fmt(best + duration)])
```

def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

    return f"{m // 60:02d}:{m % 60:02d}"

DAY = "Monday"
WORK_START = to_minutes("09:00")
WORK_END = to_minutes("17:00")
DURATION = 30

busy = {
    "Christine": [
        "09:30-10:30", "12:00-12:30", "13:00-13:30",
        "14:30-15:00", "16:00-16:30",
    ],
    "Janice": [],
    "Bobby": ["12:00-12:30", "14:30-15:00"],
    "Elizabeth": [
        "09:00-09:30", "11:30-13:00", "13:30-14:00",
        "15:00-15:30", "16:00-17:00",
    ],
    "Tyler": [
        "09:00-11:00", "12:00-12:30", "13:00-13:30",
        "15:30-16:00", "16:30-17:00",
    ],
    "Edward": [
        "09:00-09:30", "10:00-11:00", "11:30-14:00",
        "14:30-15:30", "16:00-17:00",
    ],
}

busy_intervals = []
for person, entries in busy.items():
    for entry in entries:
        s, e = entry.split("-")
        busy_intervals.append((to_minutes(s), to_minutes(e)))

JANICE_LATEST_END = to_minutes("13:00")

def is_free(start):
    end = start + DURATION
    if start < WORK_START or end > WORK_END:
        return False
    for b_start, b_end in busy_intervals:
        if start < b_end and b_start < end:
            return False
    if end > JANICE_LATEST_END:
        return False
    return True

for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1):
    if is_free(start):
        print([DAY, fmt(start), fmt(start + DURATION)])
        break
```

from typing import List, Tuple

# Variables
DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday"]
PARTICIPANTS = ["Natalie", "William"]
WORK_START = 9 * 60
WORK_END = 17 * 60
MEETING_DURATION = 60

# Existing busy schedule intervals; each interval is [start, end) in minutes from midnight.
BUSY_SCHEDULES = {
    "Monday": {
        "Natalie": [
            ("9:00", "9:30"), ("10:00", "12:00"), ("12:30", "13:00"),
            ("14:00", "14:30"), ("15:00", "16:30")
        ],
        "William": [
            ("9:30", "11:00"), ("11:30", "17:00")
        ],
    },
...
}

def to_minutes(t: str) -> int:
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h*60 + m

def overlaps(start: int, end: int, intervals: List[Tuple[str,str]]) -> bool:
    for s, e in intervals:
        bs, be = to_minutes(s), to_minutes(e)
        if start < be and bs < end:
            return True
    return False

def fmt(t: int) -> str:
    return f"{t//60:02d}:{t%60:02d}"

# Constraint: the meeting must be completely inside work hours and not overlap a busy interval.
for day in DAYS:
    for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - MEETING_DURATION + 1):
        end = start + MEETING_DURATION
        if all(not overlaps(start, end, BUSY_SCHEDULES[day][p]) for p in PARTICIPANTS):
            print([day, fmt(start), fmt(end)])
            raise SystemExit(0)
```

def to_minutes(time_str):
    hours, minutes = map(int, time_str.split(":"))
    return hours * 60 + minutes

def to_hhmm(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

def is_overlap(meeting_start, meeting_end, busy_start, busy_end):
    return meeting_start < busy_end and busy_start < meeting_end

def main():
    work_start = to_minutes("09:00")
    work_end = to_minutes("17:00")
    meeting_duration = 60

    schedules = {
        "Martha": {
            "Monday": [("16:00", "17:00")],
            "Tuesday": [("15:00", "15:30")],
            "Wednesday": [("10:00", "11:00"), ("14:00", "14:30")],
        },
        "Beverly": {
            "Monday": [("09:00", "13:30"), ("14:00", "17:00")],
            "Tuesday": [("09:00", "17:00")],
            "Wednesday": [("09:30", "15:30"), ("16:30", "17:00")],
        },
    }

    days = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday"]
    participants = ["Martha", "Beverly"]

    busy_minutes = {
        day: {
            participant: [
                (to_minutes(start), to_minutes(end))
                for start, end in schedules[participant][day]
            ]
            for participant in participants
        }
        for day in days
    }

    for day in days:
        for start in range(work_start, work_end - meeting_duration + 1):
            end = start + meeting_duration
            if all(
                not any(
                    is_overlap(start, end, busy_start, busy_end)
                    for busy_start, busy_end in busy_minutes[day][participant]
                )
                for participant in participants
            ):
                print([day, to_hhmm(start), to_hhmm(end)])
                return

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    h, m = map(int, hhmm.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday"]

def parse_schedule(data):
    parsed = {}
    for person, days in data.items():
        parsed[person] = {}
        for day, intervals in days.items():
            parsed[person][day] = [(to_minutes(start), to_minutes(end)) for start, end in intervals]
    return parsed

SCHEDULES = parse_schedule({
    "John": {day: [] for day in DAYS},
    "Jennifer": {
        "Monday": [
            ("09:00", "11:00"),
            ("11:30", "13:00"),
            ("13:30", "14:30"),
            ("15:00", "17:00"),
        ],

            ("12:00", "17:00"),
        ],

            ("12:00", "12:30"),

            ("14:30", "16:00"),
            ("16:30", "17:00"),
        ],
    },
})

AVOID = parse_schedule({
    "John": {
        "Monday": [("14:30", "17:00")],
        "Tuesday": [("09:00", "17:00")],
        "Wednesday": [("09:00", "17:00")],
    },
    "Jennifer": {day: [] for day in DAYS},
})

def overlaps(start, end, intervals):
    for interval_start, interval_end in intervals:
        if start < interval_end and end > interval_start:
            return True
    return False

def available(person, day, start, end):
    if overlaps(start, end, SCHEDULES[person][day]):
        return False
    if overlaps(start, end, AVOID[person][day]):
        return False
    return True

        if all(available(person, day, start, end) for person in PEOPLE):

    if answer:
        break

import sys

DAY = "Monday"
WORK_START = "09:00"
WORK_END = "17:00"
DURATION_MIN = 30

PARTICIPANTS = ["Jacob", "Diana", "Adam", "Angela", "Dennis"]

BUSY = {
    "Jacob": [("13:30", "14:00"), ("14:30", "15:00")],
    "Diana": [("09:30", "10:00"), ("11:30", "12:00"), ("13:00", "13:30"), ("16:00", "16:30")],
    "Adam": [("09:30", "10:30"), ("11:00", "12:30"), ("15:30", "16:00")],
    "Angela": [("09:30", "10:00"), ("10:30", "12:00"), ("13:00", "15:30"), ("16:00", "16:30")],
    "Dennis": [("09:00", "09:30"), ("10:30", "11:30"), ("13:00", "15:00"), ("16:30", "17:00")],
}

def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h*60 + m

def to_time(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

def overlaps(start, end, busy_start, busy_end):
    return start < busy_end and end > busy_start

work_start_min = to_minutes(WORK_START)
work_end_min = to_minutes(WORK_END)
duration = DURATION_MIN

for start in range(work_start_min, work_end_min - duration + 1, duration):
    end = start + duration
    available = True
    for participant in PARTICIPANTS:
        for busy_start, busy_end in BUSY[participant]:
            bs = to_minutes(busy_start)
            be = to_minutes(busy_end)
            if overlaps(start, end, bs, be):
                available = False
                break
        if not available:
            break
    if available:
        print([DAY, to_time(start), to_time(end)])
        sys.exit(0)

        (minutes(14), minutes(14, 30)),
        (minutes(16, 30), minutes(17)),

```python
def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def to_hhmm(mins):
    return f"{mins // 60:02d}:{mins % 60:02d}"

PEOPLE = ["Joe", "Keith", "Patricia", "Nancy", "Pamela"]

WORK_START = to_minutes("09:00")
WORK_END = to_minutes("17:00")
MEETING_DURATION = 30
SLOT_STEP = 30

BUSY = {
    "Joe": [
        (to_minutes("09:30"), to_minutes("10:00")),
        (to_minutes("10:30"), to_minutes("11:00")),
    ],
    "Keith": [
        (to_minutes("11:30"), to_minutes("12:00")),
        (to_minutes("15:00"), to_minutes("15:30")),
    ],
    "Patricia": [
        (to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("09:30")),
        (to_minutes("13:00"), to_minutes("13:30")),
    ],
    "Nancy": [
        (to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("11:00")),
        (to_minutes("11:30"), to_minutes("16:30")),
    ],
    "Pamela": [
        (to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("10:00")),
        (to_minutes("10:30"), to_minutes("11:00")),
        (to_minutes("11:30"), to_minutes("12:30")),
        (to_minutes("13:00"), to_minutes("14:00")),
        (to_minutes("14:30"), to_minutes("15:00")),
        (to_minutes("15:30"), to_minutes("16:00")),
        (to_minutes("16:30"), to_minutes("17:00")),
    ],
}

def is_available(person, start, end):
    for busy_start, busy_end in BUSY[person]:
        if start < busy_end and end > busy_start:
            return False
    return True

def find_meeting_slot():
    start = WORK_START
    while start + MEETING_DURATION <= WORK_END:
        end = start + MEETING_DURATION
        if all(is_available(p, start, end) for p in PEOPLE):
            return ["Monday", to_hhmm(start), to_hhmm(end)]
        start += SLOT_STEP
    return None

print(find_meeting_slot())
```

                    break

        if candidate_start < end and candidate_end > start:

            merged.append([start, end])
        else:

    return [(start, end) for start, end in merged]

def free_intervals(busy, work_start, work_end):
    free = []
    cursor = work_start
    for start, end in busy:
        if end <= cursor:
            continue
        if start >= work_end:
            break
        if start > cursor:
            free.append((cursor, min(start, work_end)))
        cursor = max(cursor, end)
        if cursor >= work_end:
            break
    if cursor < work_end:
        free.append((cursor, work_end))
    return free

def intersect_intervals(a, b):
    i = j = 0
    result = []
    while i < len(a) and j < len(b):

        end = min(a[i][1], b[j][1])
        if start < end:
            result.append((start, end))
        if a[i][1] < b[j][1]:
            i += 1
        else:
            j += 1
    return result

def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def to_hhmm(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

def merge_intervals(intervals):
    intervals = sorted(intervals)
    merged = []
    for start, end in intervals:
        if not merged or start > merged[-1][1]:
            merged.append([start, end])
        else:
            merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], end)
    return [(s, e) for s, e in merged]

def free_intervals(busy, work_start, work_end):
    free = []
    cursor = work_start
    for start, end in busy:
        if end <= cursor:
            continue
        if start >= work_end:
            break
        if start > cursor:
            free.append((cursor, min(start, work_end)))
        cursor = max(cursor, end)
        if cursor >= work_end:
            break
    if cursor < work_end:
        free.append((cursor, work_end))
    return free

def intersect_intervals(a, b):
    i = j = 0
    result = []
    while i < len(a) and j < len(b):
        start = max(a[i][0], b[j][0])
        end = min(a[i][1], b[j][1])
        if start < end:
            result.append((start, end))
        if a[i][1] < b[j][1]:
            i += 1
        else:
            j += 1
    return result

def to_minutes(time_str):
    hours, minutes = map(int, time_str.split(":"))
    return hours * 60 + minutes

def to_hhmm(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

def merge_intervals(intervals):
    intervals = sorted(intervals)
    merged = []
    for start, end in intervals:
        if not merged or start > merged[-1][1]:
            merged.append([start, end])
        else:
            merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], end)
    return [(start, end) for start, end in merged]

def free_intervals(busy, work_start, work_end):
    free = []
    cursor = work_start
    for start, end in busy:
        if end <= cursor:
            continue
        if start >= work_end:
            break
        if start > cursor:
            free.append((cursor, min(start, work_end)))
        cursor = max(cursor, end)
        if cursor >= work_end:
            break
    if cursor < work_end:
        free.append((cursor, work_end))
    return free

def intersect_intervals(first, second):
    i = j = 0
    result = []
    while i < len(first) and j < len(second):
        start = max(first[i][0], second[j][0])
        end = min(first[i][1], second[j][1])
        if start < end:
            result.append((start, end))
        if first[i][1] < second[j][1]:
            i += 1
        else:
            j += 1
    return result

DAY = "Monday"

WORK_END = to_minutes("17:00")
DURATION = 30
ANGELA_AVOID_BEFORE = to_minutes("15:00")

    "Carl": [("09:00", "11:00"), ("11:30", "12:30"), ("13:00", "14:30"), ("15:00", "16:00"), ("16:30", "17:00")],
}

PEOPLE = ["Katherine", "Rebecca", "Julie", "Angela", "Nicholas", "Carl"]

    availability[person] = free_intervals(busy, WORK_START, WORK_END)

def free_intervals(busy, work_start, work_end):
    free = []
    cursor = work_start
    for start, end in busy:
        if end <= cursor:
            continue
        if start >= work_end:
            break
        if start > cursor:
            free.append((cursor, min(start, work_end)))
        cursor = max(cursor, end)
        if cursor >= work_end:
            break
    if cursor < work_end:
        free.append((cursor, work_end))
    return free
```

def merge_intervals(intervals):
    intervals = sorted(intervals)
    merged = []
    for start, end in intervals:
        if not merged or start > merged[-1][1]:
            merged.append([start, end])
        else:
            merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], end)
    return [(start, end) for start, end in merged]

def free_intervals(busy, work_start, work_end):
    free = []
    cursor = work_start
    for start, end in busy:
        if end <= cursor:
            continue
        if start >= work_end:
            break
        if start > cursor:
            free.append((cursor, min(start, work_end)))
        cursor = max(cursor, end)
        if cursor >= work_end:
            break
    if cursor < work_end:
        free.append((cursor, work_end))
    return free

def intersect_intervals(a, b):
    i = j = 0
    result = []
    while i < len(a) and j < len(b):
        start = max(a[i][0], b[j][0])
        end = min(a[i][1], b[j][1])
        if start < end:
            result.append((start, end))
        if a[i][1] < b[j][1]:
            i += 1
        else:
            j += 1
    return result

```python
def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def to_hhmm(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

def merge_intervals(intervals):
    intervals = sorted(intervals)
    merged = []
    for start, end in intervals:
        if not merged or start > merged[-1][1]:
            merged.append([start, end])
        else:
            merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], end)
    return [(s, e) for s, e in merged]

def free_intervals(busy, work_start, work_end):
    free = []
    cursor = work_start
    for start, end in busy:
        if end <= cursor:
            continue
        if start >= work_end:
            break
        if start > cursor:
            free.append((cursor, min(start, work_end)))
        cursor = max(cursor, end)
        if cursor >= work_end:
            break
    if cursor < work_end:
        free.append((cursor, work_end))
    return free

def intersect_intervals(a, b):
    i = j = 0
    result = []
    while i < len(a) and j < len(b):
        start = max(a[i][0], b[j][0])
        end = min(a[i][1], b[j][1])
        if start < end:
            result.append((start, end))
        if a[i][1] < b[j][1]:
            i += 1
        else:
            j += 1
    return result

DAY = "Monday"
WORK_START = to_minutes("09:00")
WORK_END = to_minutes("17:00")
DURATION = 30
PREFER_NOT_BEFORE = to_minutes("15:00")

schedules = {
    "Katherine": [("12:00", "12:30"), ("13:00", "14:30")],

    "Julie": [("09:00", "09:30"), ("10:30", "11:00"), ("13:30", "14:00"), ("15:00", "15:30")],

    "Carl": [("09:00", "11:00"), ("11:30", "12:30"), ("13:00", "14:30"), ("15:00", "16:00"), ("16:30", "17:00")],
}

availability = {}

def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def to_time(mins):
    return f"{mins // 60:02d}:{mins % 60:02d}"

def overlaps(start, end, busy_intervals):
    for busy_start, busy_end in busy_intervals:
        if start < busy_end and end > busy_start:
            return True
    return False

def main():
    work_start = to_minutes("09:00")
    work_end = to_minutes("17:00")
    duration = 30
    day = "Monday"

    schedule = {
        "Raymond": [
            (to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("09:30")),
            (to_minutes("11:30"), to_minutes("12:00")),
            (to_minutes("13:00"), to_minutes("13:30")),
            (to_minutes("15:00"), to_minutes("15:30")),
        ],
        "Billy": [
            (to_minutes("10:00"), to_minutes("10:30")),
            (to_minutes("12:00"), to_minutes("13:00")),
            (to_minutes("16:30"), to_minutes("17:00")),
        ],
        "Donald": [
            (to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("09:30")),
            (to_minutes("10:00"), to_minutes("11:00")),
            (to_minutes("12:00"), to_minutes("13:00")),
            (to_minutes("14:00"), to_minutes("14:30")),
            (to_minutes("16:00"), to_minutes("17:00")),
        ],
    }

    billy_no_after = to_minutes("15:00")

    for start in range(work_start, work_end - duration + 1):
        end = start + duration
        if end > billy_no_after:
            continue
        if all(not overlaps(start, end, intervals) for intervals in schedule.values()):
            print([day, to_time(start), to_time(end)])
            return

main()

day = "Monday"
work_start = 9 * 60
work_end = 17 * 60
duration = 30
bobby_pref_end = 15 * 60

def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

busy_intervals = {
    "Lisa": [
        ("09:00", "10:00"),
        ("10:30", "11:30"),
        ("12:30", "13:00"),
        ("16:00", "16:30"),
    ],
    "Bobby": [
        ("09:00", "09:30"),
        ("10:00", "10:30"),
        ("11:30", "12:00"),
        ("15:00", "15:30"),
    ],
    "Randy": [
        ("09:30", "10:00"),
        ("10:30", "11:00"),
        ("11:30", "12:30"),
        ("13:00", "13:30"),
        ("14:30", "15:30"),
        ("16:00", "16:30"),
    ],
}

busy = {
    name: [(to_minutes(s), to_minutes(e)) for s, e in intervals]
    for name, intervals in busy_intervals.items()
}

def is_free(start, end, intervals):
    return not any(start < e and end > s for s, e in intervals)

def feasible(start, end):
    if start < work_start or end > work_end:
        return False
    if end > bobby_pref_end:
        return False
    return all(is_free(start, end, busy[p]) for p in ("Lisa", "Bobby", "Randy"))

def fmt(m):
    return f"{m // 60:02d}:{m % 60:02d}"

meeting = None
for start in range(work_start, work_end - duration + 1):
    end = start + duration
    if feasible(start, end):
        meeting = (start, end)
        break

from itertools import product
from typing import List, Tuple

WORK_START = 9 * 60
WORK_END = 17 * 60
DURATION = 60
DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday"]

def parse_time(t: str) -> int:
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def fmt_time(minutes: int) -> str:
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

def overlaps(start: int, end: int, busy_start: int, busy_end: int) -> bool:
    return start < busy_end and end > busy_start

def available(start: int, end: int, busy_intervals: List[Tuple[int, int]]) -> bool:
    return all(not overlaps(start, end, bs, be) for bs, be in busy_intervals)

schedules = {
    "Megan": {
        "Monday": [(780,810),(840,930)], ...
    },
    "Daniel": ...
}

def find_earliest():
    for day in DAYS:
        for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1):
            end = start + DURATION
            if available(start, end, schedules["Megan"][day]) and available(start, end, schedules["Daniel"][day]):
                return [day, fmt_time(start), fmt_time(end)]
    return None

answer = find_earliest()
print(answer)
```

from typing import List, Tuple

# Variables
DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday"]
PARTICIPANTS = ["Natalie", "William"]
WORK_START = 9 * 60

MEETING_DURATION = 60

# Existing busy schedule intervals; each interval is [start, end) in minutes from midnight.
BUSY_SCHEDULES = {
    "Monday": {
        "Natalie": [
            ("9:00", "9:30"), ("10:00", "12:00"), ("12:30", "13:00"),
            ("14:00", "14:30"), ("15:00", "16:30")
        ],
        "William": [
            ("9:30", "11:00"), ("11:30", "17:00")
        ],
    },
...
}

def to_minutes(t: str) -> int:
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h*60 + m

def overlaps(start: int, end: int, intervals: List[Tuple[str,str]]) -> bool:
    for s, e in intervals:
        bs, be = to_minutes(s), to_minutes(e)
        if start < be and bs < end:
            return True
    return False

def fmt(t: int) -> str:
    return f"{t//60:02d}:{t%60:02d}"

# Constraint: the meeting must be completely inside work hours and not overlap a busy interval.
for day in DAYS:
    for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - MEETING_DURATION + 1):
        end = start + MEETING_DURATION
        if all(not overlaps(start, end, BUSY_SCHEDULES[day][p]) for p in PARTICIPANTS):
            print([day, fmt(start), fmt(end)])
            raise SystemExit(0)

def to_minutes(time_str):
    hours, minutes = map(int, time_str.split(":"))
    return hours * 60 + minutes

def to_time_string(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

WORK_START = to_minutes("09:00")
WORK_END = to_minutes("17:00")
MEETING_LENGTH = 30
RUTH_WEDNESDAY_LATEST_END = to_minutes("13:30")

DAYS = ("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday")
PARTICIPANTS = ("Nicole", "Ruth")

BUSY = {
    "Nicole": {
        "Monday": [
            (to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("09:30")),
            (to_minutes("13:00"), to_minutes("13:30")),
            (to_minutes("14:30"), to_minutes("15:30")),
        ],
        "Tuesday": [
            (to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("09:30")),
            (to_minutes("11:30"), to_minutes("13:30")),
            (to_minutes("14:30"), to_minutes("15:30")),
        ],
        "Wednesday": [
            (to_minutes("10:00"), to_minutes("11:00")),
            (to_minutes("12:30"), to_minutes("15:00")),
            (to_minutes("16:00"), to_minutes("17:00")),
        ],
    },
    "Ruth": {
        "Monday": [
            (to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("17:00")),
        ],
        "Tuesday": [
            (to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("17:00")),
        ],
        "Wednesday": [
            (to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("10:30")),
            (to_minutes("11:00"), to_minutes("11:30")),
            (to_minutes("12:00"), to_minutes("12:30")),
            (to_minutes("13:30"), to_minutes("15:30")),
            (to_minutes("16:00"), to_minutes("16:30")),
        ],
    },
}

def overlaps(start_a, end_a, start_b, end_b):
    return start_a < end_b and end_a > start_b

def meets_preferences(day, start, end):
    if day == "Wednesday" and end > RUTH_WEDNESDAY_LATEST_END:
        return False
    return True

def is_available(day, start, end):
    if start < WORK_START or end > WORK_END:
        return False
    if not meets_preferences(day, start, end):
        return False
    for participant in PARTICIPANTS:
        for busy_start, busy_end in BUSY[participant][day]:
            if overlaps(start, end, busy_start, busy_end):
                return False
    return True

def find_meeting():
    for day in DAYS:
        for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - MEETING_LENGTH + 1):
            end = start + MEETING_LENGTH
            if is_available(day, start, end):
                return [day, to_time_string(start), to_time_string(end)]
    return None

print(find_meeting())

    h, m = map(int, t.split(':'))

        if all(is_free(p, start, end) for p in busy):

    return None

    "Arthur": {

```python
WORK_START = 9 * 60
WORK_END = 17 * 60
DURATION = 30

DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday"]

def to_minutes(hour, minute):
    return hour * 60 + minute

def fmt(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

busy = {
    "Bobby": {
        "Monday": [(to_minutes(14, 30), to_minutes(15, 0))],
        "Tuesday": [
            (to_minutes(9, 0), to_minutes(11, 30)),
            (to_minutes(12, 0), to_minutes(12, 30)),
            (to_minutes(13, 0), to_minutes(15, 0)),
            (to_minutes(15, 30), to_minutes(17, 0)),
        ],
    },
    "Michael": {
        "Monday": [
            (to_minutes(9, 0), to_minutes(10, 0)),
            (to_minutes(10, 30), to_minutes(13, 30)),
            (to_minutes(14, 0), to_minutes(15, 0)),
            (to_minutes(15, 30), to_minutes(17, 0)),
        ],
        "Tuesday": [
            (to_minutes(9, 0), to_minutes(10, 30)),
            (to_minutes(11, 0), to_minutes(11, 30)),
            (to_minutes(12, 0), to_minutes(14, 0)),
            (to_minutes(15, 0), to_minutes(16, 0)),
            (to_minutes(16, 30), to_minutes(17, 0)),
        ],
    },
}

def is_free(day, start):
    end = start + DURATION
    if start < WORK_START or end > WORK_END:
        return False
    for person_busy in busy.values():
        for b_start, b_end in person_busy.get(day, []):
            if start < b_end and end > b_start:
                return False
    return True

answer = None
for day in DAYS:
    for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1):
        if is_free(day, start):
            answer = [day, fmt(start), fmt(start + DURATION)]
            break
    if answer is not None:
        break

print(answer)
```

from datetime import datetime

DAY = "Monday"
WORK_START = 9 * 60
WORK_END = 17 * 60
DURATION = 30

def to_min(hhmm):
    h, m = map(int, hhmm.split(':'))
    return h * 60 + m

def fmt(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

participants = {
    "Margaret": [(to_min("09:00"), to_min("10:00")), (to_min("10:30"), to_min("11:00")), ...],
    "Donna": [...],
    "Helen": [...]
}

def overlaps(start, end, busy_start, busy_end):
    return start < busy_end and busy_start < end
    # Using half-open busy intervals.
    # If meeting start = busy_end, no overlap.
def is_free(person, start, end):
    return not any(start < b_end and b_start < end for b_start,b_end in participants[person])

def valid(start):
    end = start + DURATION
    if start < WORK_START or end > WORK_END:
        return False
    if not all(is_free(p, start, end) for p in participants):
        return False
    # Helen does not want to meet after 13:30. She cannot attend any part of the meeting after 13:30.
    if end > to_min("13:30"):
        return False
    return True

answer = None
for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1):  # minute granularity
    if valid(start):
        answer = [DAY, fmt(start), fmt(start+DURATION)]
        break

print(answer)
```

                      (16 * 60, 17 * 60)],

def to_minutes(hhmm):
    h, m = map(int, hhmm.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def to_hhmm(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

WORK_START = to_minutes("09:00")
WORK_END = to_minutes("17:00")
DURATION = 30

# Juan's "cannot meet after 16:00" is represented as busy from 16:00 to 17:00.
busy = {
    "Juan": [
        (to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("10:30")),
        (to_minutes("15:30"), to_minutes("16:00")),
        (to_minutes("16:00"), to_minutes("17:00")),
    ],
    "Marilyn": [
        (to_minutes("11:00"), to_minutes("11:30")),
        (to_minutes("12:30"), to_minutes("13:00")),
    ],
    "Ronald": [
        (to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("10:30")),
        (to_minutes("12:00"), to_minutes("12:30")),
        (to_minutes("13:00"), to_minutes("13:30")),
        (to_minutes("14:00"), to_minutes("16:30")),
    ],
}

def overlaps(start, end, b_start, b_end):
    return start < b_end and b_start < end

def available(participant, start, end):
    return all(not overlaps(start, end, b_start, b_end) for b_start, b_end in busy[participant])

meeting_start = None
for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1):
    end = start + DURATION
    if all(available(p, start, end) for p in busy):
        meeting_start = start
        break

print(["Monday", to_hhmm(meeting_start), to_hhmm(meeting_start + DURATION)])

def parse_time(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(':'))
    return h * 60 + m

def fmt_time(t):
    return f"{t // 60:02d}:{t % 60:02d}"

WORK_START = parse_time("09:00")
WORK_END = parse_time("17:00")
DURATION = 60

blocked = {
    "Judith": {
        "Monday": [(parse_time("12:00"), parse_time("12:30"))],
        "Wednesday": [(parse_time("11:30"), parse_time("12:00"))],
    },
    "Timothy": {
        "Monday": [
            (parse_time("09:30"), parse_time("10:00")),
            (parse_time("10:30"), parse_time("11:30")),
            (parse_time("12:30"), parse_time("14:00")),
            (parse_time("15:30"), parse_time("17:00")),
        ],
        "Tuesday": [
            (parse_time("09:30"), parse_time("13:00")),
            (parse_time("13:30"), parse_time("14:00")),
            (parse_time("14:30"), parse_time("17:00")),
        ],
        "Wednesday": [
            (parse_time("09:00"), parse_time("09:30")),
            (parse_time("10:30"), parse_time("11:00")),
            (parse_time("13:30"), parse_time("14:30")),
            (parse_time("15:00"), parse_time("15:30")),
            (parse_time("16:00"), parse_time("16:30")),
        ],
    },
}

days = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday"]
participants = ["Judith", "Timothy"]

def is_free(day, start, end, person):
    for b_start, b_end in blocked[person].get(day, []):
        if start < b_end and end > b_start:
            return False
    return True

def preferences_ok(day, start):
    if day == "Monday":
        return False
    if day != "Wednesday" or start >= parse_time("12:00"):

    return True

def works(day, start):
    end = start + DURATION
    if start < WORK_START or end > WORK_END:
        return False
    if not preferences_ok(day, start):
        return False
    for person in participants:
        if not is_free(day, start, end, person):
            return False
    return True

solution = None
for day in days:
    for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1, 30):
        if works(day, start):
            solution = [day, fmt_time(start), fmt_time(start + DURATION)]
            break
    if solution is not None:
        break

print(solution)

# Meeting variables: day, start; end = start + 60.
# Work window: 09:00-17:00. Wednesday is forbidden for Philip.
# Constraint: for Laura and Philip, the selected interval must not overlap any busy interval.

WORK_START = 9 * 60
WORK_END = 17 * 60
DURATION = 60
FORBIDDEN_DAYS = {"Wednesday"}

def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def to_hhmm(m):
    return f"{m // 60:02d}:{m % 60:02d}"

def parse_interval(s):
    a, b = s.split("-")
    return to_minutes(a), to_minutes(b)

SCHEDULE = { ... }

BUSY = {
    day: {
        person: [parse_interval(i) for i in intervals]
        for person, intervals in people.items()
    }
    for day, people in SCHEDULE.items()
}

def is_free(day, start, end):
    if day in FORBIDDEN_DAYS:
        return False
    if start < WORK_START or end > WORK_END:
        return False
    for intervals in BUSY[day].values():
        for b_start, b_end in intervals:
            if start < b_end and end > b_start:
                return False
    return True

def main():
    for day in ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday"]:
        for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1):
            end = start + DURATION
            if is_free(day, start, end):
                print([day, to_hhmm(start), to_hhmm(end)])

```python
WORK_START = 9 * 60
WORK_END = 17 * 60
DURATION = 60
FORBIDDEN_DAYS = {"Wednesday"}

def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def to_hhmm(m):
    return f"{m // 60:02d}:{m % 60:02d}"

def parse_interval(s):
    a, b = s.split("-")
    return to_minutes(a), to_minutes(b)

SCHEDULE = {
    "Monday": {
        "Laura": ["10:30-11:00", "12:30-13:00", "14:30-15:30", "16:00-17:00"],
        "Philip": ["09:00-17:00"],
    },
    "Tuesday": {
        "Laura": ["09:30-10:00", "11:00-11:30", "13:00-13:30", "14:30-15:00", "16:00-17:00"],
        "Philip": ["09:00-11:00", "11:30-12:00", "13:00-13:30", "14:00-14:30", "15:00-16:30"],
    },
    "Wednesday": {
        "Laura": ["11:30-12:00", "12:30-13:00", "15:30-16:30"],
        "Philip": ["09:00-10:00", "11:00-12:00", "12:30-16:00", "16:30-17:00"],
    },
    "Thursday": {
        "Laura": ["10:30-11:00", "12:00-13:30", "15:00-15:30", "16:00-16:30"],
        "Philip": ["09:00-10:30", "11:00-12:30", "13:00-17:00"],
    },
}

BUSY = {
    day: {
        person: [parse_interval(i) for i in intervals]
        for person, intervals in people.items()
    }
    for day, people in SCHEDULE.items()
}

def is_free(day, start, end):
    if day in FORBIDDEN_DAYS:
        return False
    if start < WORK_START or end > WORK_END:
        return False
    for intervals in BUSY[day].values():
        for b_start, b_end in intervals:
            if start < b_end and end > b_start:
                return False
    return True

def main():
    days = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday"]
    for day in days:
        for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1):
            end = start + DURATION
            if is_free(day, start, end):
                print([day, to_hhmm(start), to_hhmm(end)])
                return

main()
```

def parse_time(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(':'))
    return h * 60 + m

def format_time(m):
    return f"{m // 60:02d}:{m % 60:02d}"

def overlaps(start, end, busy_start, busy_end):
    return start < busy_end and busy_start < end

def main():

                    break

                print([day, format_time(start), format_time(end)])
                return

if __name__ == "__main__":

def to_minutes(time_str):
    hours, minutes = map(int, time_str.split(":"))
    return hours * 60 + minutes

def to_hhmm(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

def is_overlap(meeting_start, meeting_end, busy_start, busy_end):
    return meeting_start < busy_end and busy_start < meeting_end

def main():
    work_start = to_minutes("09:00")
    work_end = to_minutes("17:00")
    meeting_duration = 60

    schedules = {
        "Martha": {
            "Monday": [("16:00", "17:00")],
            "Tuesday": [("15:00", "15:30")],
            "Wednesday": [("10:00", "11:00"), ("14:00", "14:30")],
        },
        "Beverly": {
            "Monday": [("09:00", "13:30"), ("14:00", "17:00")],
            "Tuesday": [("09:00", "17:00")],
            "Wednesday": [("09:30", "15:30"), ("16:30", "17:00")],
        },
    }

    days = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday"]
    participants = ["Martha", "Beverly"]

    busy_minutes = {
        day: {
            participant: [
                (to_minutes(start), to_minutes(end))
                for start, end in schedules[participant][day]
            ]
            for participant in participants
        }
        for day in days
    }

    for day in days:
        for start in range(work_start, work_end - meeting_duration + 1):
            end = start + meeting_duration
            if all(
                not any(
                    is_overlap(start, end, busy_start, busy_end)
                    for busy_start, busy_end in busy_minutes[day][participant]
                )
                for participant in participants
            ):
                print([day, to_hhmm(start), to_hhmm(end)])
                return

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

def to_minutes(hhmm):
    h, m = map(int, hhmm.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def format_time(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

def overlaps(candidate_start, candidate_end, busy_intervals):
    for busy_start, busy_end in busy_intervals:
        if candidate_start < busy_end and candidate_end > busy_start:
            return True
    return False

def main():
    work_start = to_minutes("09:00")
    work_end = to_minutes("17:00")
    duration = 30

    busy_intervals = {
        "Joan": [
            (to_minutes("11:30"), to_minutes("12:00")),
            (to_minutes("14:30"), to_minutes("15:00")),
        ],
        "Megan": [...],
        "Austin": [],
        "Betty": [...],
        "Judith": [...],
        "Terry": [...],
        "Kathryn": [...],
    }

    for start in range(work_start, work_end - duration + 1):
        end = start + duration
        if end > work_end:
            continue
        if all(not overlaps(start, end, intervals) for intervals in busy_intervals.values()):
            print(["Monday", format_time(start), format_time(end)])
            return

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

def to_minutes(hhmm):
    h, m = map(int, hhmm.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def to_hhmm(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

def has_overlap(candidate_start, candidate_end, busy_intervals):
    for busy_start, busy_end in busy_intervals:
        if candidate_start < busy_end and candidate_end > busy_start:
            return True
    return False

def main():

    work_end = to_minutes("17:00")
    duration = 30
    day = "Monday"

            (to_minutes("14:00"), to_minutes("14:30")),
            (to_minutes("16:00"), to_minutes("16:30")),
        ],
        "Austin": [],
        "Betty": [
            (to_minutes("09:30"), to_minutes("10:00")),
            (to_minutes("11:30"), to_minutes("12:00")),

        ],

            (to_minutes("13:00"), to_minutes("14:00")),

        ],

if __name__ == "__main__":

DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday"]

        (minutes(13, 30), minutes(16)),

        (minutes(12), minutes(12, 30)),
        (minutes(13), minutes(13, 30)),
        (minutes(14), minutes(14, 30)),
        (minutes(16, 30), minutes(17)),
    ],
}

BLOCKED_DAYS = {"Wednesday", "Thursday"}  # Cheryl preference

def to_hhmm(t):

    for day in DAYS:

        meetings = JAMES_MEETINGS.get(day, [])

            overlaps = any(start < busy_end and busy_start < end

            if not overlaps:

    raise RuntimeError("No available slot found")

def minutes(hour, minute=0):
    return hour * 60 + minute

# Variables: day, start, end. Times are integer minutes since midnight.
DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday"]
WORK_START = minutes(9)
WORK_END = minutes(17)
DURATION = 30

# Cheryl's calendar is open, so James's meetings are the only occupied slots.
JAMES_MEETINGS = {
    "Monday": [
        (minutes(9), minutes(9, 30)),
        ...
    ],
    ...
}

# Cheryl prefers not to meet on Wednesday or Thursday.
BLOCKED_DAYS = {"Wednesday", "Thursday"}

def format_time(t):
    return "{:02d}:{:02d}".format(t // 60, t % 60)

def find_earliest_slot():
    for day in DAYS:
        if day in BLOCKED_DAYS:
            continue
        for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1):
            end = start + DURATION
            if not any(
                start < busy_end and busy_start < end
                for busy_start, busy_end in JAMES_MEETINGS.get(day, [])
            ):
                return [day, format_time(start), format_time(end)]
    raise RuntimeError("No available slot found")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(find_earliest_slot())
```

# Workday and meeting duration.
WORK_START = 9 * 60
WORK_END = 17 * 60
MEETING_DURATION = 30

DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday"]

# Busy intervals are stored as (start_minute, end_minute).
BUSY = {
    "Larry": {
        "Monday": [],
        "Tuesday": [],
        "Wednesday": [],
    },
    "Samuel": {
        "Monday": [
            (10 * 60 + 30, 11 * 60),
            (12 * 60, 12 * 60 + 30),
            (13 * 60, 15 * 60),
            (15 * 60 + 30, 16 * 60 + 30),
        ],
        "Tuesday": [
            (9 * 60, 12 * 60),
            (14 * 60, 15 * 60 + 30),
            (16 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60),
        ],
        "Wednesday": [
            (10 * 60 + 30, 11 * 60),
            (11 * 60 + 30, 12 * 60),
            (12 * 60 + 30, 13 * 60),
            (14 * 60, 14 * 60 + 30),
            (15 * 60, 16 * 60),
        ],
    },
}

def is_free(person, day, start):
    end = start + MEETING_DURATION
    for busy_start, busy_end in BUSY[person][day]:
        if start < busy_end and end > busy_start:
            return False
    return True

def format_minutes(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

candidates = []
for day in DAYS:
    for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - MEETING_DURATION + 1):
        if all(is_free(person, day, start) for person in BUSY):
            candidates.append((day, start))

best_day, best_start = min(candidates, key=lambda item: (DAYS.index(item[0]), item[1]))
print([best_day, format_minutes(best_start), format_minutes(best_start + MEETING_DURATION)])
```
